properties.name: Midtown West

properties.name: Stuyvesant Town
properties.source: OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via Overpass API — OSM has no boundary=place relation for Stuyvesant Town; this is the closed landuse=residential way 170294693 that maps the Stuyvesant Town complex itself (First Ave to Ave C, E 14th to E 20th). Peter Cooper Village (way 170294692, E 20th to E 23rd) is mapped separately in OSM and is not included here.

properties.name: Sutton Place
properties.source: OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via Overpass API — OSM has no boundary=place relation for Sutton Place (only place node 11676529765, "Sutton"); this is the portion of the Midtown East relation 8398091 east of First Avenue between E 53rd St and E 59th St, clipped along those three streets’ real OSM centerlines. The eastern edge is the relation’s real East River shoreline.

properties.name: Roosevelt Island
properties.source: OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via Overpass API — OSM has no boundary=place relation for Roosevelt Island (only place node 9423354112); this is the island’s coastline from multipolygon relation 2389564 (place=island), outer ring assembled from member ways. As an island, the coastline IS the neighborhood boundary.

properties.name: Upper East Side

properties.name: Carnegie Hill
properties.source: OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via Overpass API, relation 8398083 (boundary=place), ring assembled from member ways; a sub-neighborhood of the Upper East Side — this polygon sits inside (and honestly overlaps) the Upper East Side relation 8398088
